item.title: Oxide and Friends 10/5/2026 -- Working on Wicked Problems
item.description:
Wicked problems defy simple solutions. Even as we describe the problem, we may be presupposing particular solutions and narrowing scope. Our greatest, most persistent societal problems fit this model. Wicked problems may not be solvable, but progress can be made. Noah Harlan joins us to describe his technical entrepreneurship battling wicked problems.

item.title: Oxide and Friends 10/12/2026 -- Oxide's $445m Series D
item.description:
After raising $200M in February... we raised another $445M in July! Your favorite computer company is capitalized to the gills--enough to weather the supply chain upheaval even! Come for co-founders Steve and Bryan describing the raise; stay for tax, debt, and credit talk with Scott Orn.
Notes: https://github.com/oxidecomputer/oxide-and-friends/blob/master/2026_10_12.md

item.title: Oxide and Friends 10/19/2026 -- Dead Printers Tell No Tales
item.description:
We've talked about Oxide's Root of Trust--the hardware underpinning the security of the product--but how do we keep a bad actor from spoofing Oxide to load malicious software? Philip Tricca joined Bryan and Adam to describe the key ceremony, the process of creating and storing the secret that plays a critical role in manufacturing. And we paid our respects to the dot matrix printers that made the ultimate sacrifice in the name of security.
Notes: https://github.com/oxidecomputer/oxide-and-friends/blob/master/2026_10_19.md

item.title: Oxide and Friends 11/9/2026 -- The Power of the Purse with Libby Cantrill
item.description:
Earlier this month we saw what was perhaps the most transformative electoral shift since 1974. What can we expect from the incoming Congress? Bryan and Adam were joined by none other than Bryan's sister, Libby Cantrill, head of public policy at PIMCO to discuss.
